name: VatsimPilotPosition
description: One pilot position report from the VATSIM network, transcribed from the net.vatsim.PilotPosition event of the real-time-sources feeder. The sample exists because three of its fields are short codes whose meaning lives in registers maintained by the International Civil Aviation Organization, and a code is not its meaning: `B77W` is an aircraft type only because Doc 8643 says so, and `EGLL` is an aerodrome only because Doc 7910 says so. It demonstrates `codedValues` binding each coded field to the list it draws from, and it demonstrates the division of labour between `reference` and `kind` that the keyword rests on. All three codes share the `kind` `icao`, because ICAO is the register model behind them, yet the aircraft type designator and the two location indicators are three entries in two different lists, and it is `reference` — not `kind` — that says which list each field draws from.

callsign.description: ATC-style callsign the pilot flies under this session, from the `callsign` field. It identifies the flight the report is about.

cid.description: VATSIM Certificate Identifier of the pilot, from the `cid` field.

aircraft_short.description: ICAO aircraft type designator from the filed flight plan, from the `aircraft_short` field, such as `B77W` or `A320`.

departure.description: ICAO location indicator of the departure aerodrome, from the `departure` field, such as `EGLL`.

arrival.description: ICAO location indicator of the arrival aerodrome, from the `arrival` field. It draws from the same list as `departure`, so it carries the same `reference`.

latitude.description: Aircraft latitude in WGS-84 decimal degrees, from the `latitude` field.

longitude.description: Aircraft longitude in WGS-84 decimal degrees, from the `longitude` field.

altitude.description: Indicated altitude above mean sea level, from the `altitude` field.

last_updated.description: Time the network last refreshed this pilot's data, from the `last_updated` field.
